<thought>To find the template that disconnects the sulfonamide into a sulfonyl chloride and an amine, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a “sulfonamides” functional group. This should return the template (with its ID and mapped reaction SMILES) that, when applied to the target sulfonamide, yields the two precursors given earlier.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(=O)(C1=CC(F)=CC=C1)Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
